subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the transfer beam between Structural General Notes

messages.text: The transfer beam reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with a revised bar splice noted in Sheet S-301. We would like this resolved ahead of the next concrete pour. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour. We need direction by end of day Wednesday. Some on our side would call this more pressing than others do -- it's a judgment call either way.
Proceed with a revised bar splice per Sheet S-301; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour.
